using ll = long long;

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, flow, cost;
    Edge() = default;
    Edge(int to, int cap, int flow, int cost) : to(to), cap(cap), flow(flow), cost(cost) {}
};

const int MAXN = 14043;
vector<Edge> edges;
vector<int> adj[MAXN];

ll totalCost = 0;
ll dist[MAXN];
int parent[MAXN];
int parentEdge[MAXN];
bool inQueue[MAXN];
const ll INF = (ll)1e18;

int S = MAXN - 2;
int T = MAXN - 1;

int residualCapacity(int id) {
    return edges[id].cap - edges[id].flow;
}

void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    adj[u].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(v, cap, 0, cost);
    adj[v].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(u, 0, 0, -cost);
}

void augmentOne() {
    fill(dist, dist + MAXN, INF);
    fill(parent, parent + MAXN, -1);
    fill(parentEdge, parentEdge + MAXN, -1);
    fill(inQueue, inQueue + MAXN, false);

    dist[S] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(S);
    inQueue[S] = true;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int v = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inQueue[v] = false;

        for (int id : adj[v]) {
            if (residualCapacity(id) == 0) continue;
            int to = edges[id].to;
            int w = edges[id].cost;
            if (dist[to] > dist[v] + w) {
                dist[to] = dist[v] + w;
                parent[to] = v;
                parentEdge[to] = id;
                if (!inQueue[to]) {
                    inQueue[to] = true;
                    q.push(to);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int cur = T;
    while (cur != S) {
        int id = parentEdge[cur];
        edges[id].flow++;
        edges[id ^ 1].flow--;
        cur = parent[cur];
    }

    totalCost += dist[T];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        addEdge(S, x, 1, 0);
    }

    const int TIMES = 101;

    for (int i = 0; i < TIMES; ++i) {
        addEdge(i * n, T, k, i * c);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        --x;
        --y;

        for (int tm = 0; tm < TIMES - 1; ++tm) {
            for (int p = 0; p < k; ++p) {
                addEdge(x + tm * n, y + (tm + 1) * n, 1, d * (2 * p + 1));
            }
        }
        for (int tm = 0; tm < TIMES - 1; ++tm) {
            for (int p = 0; p < k; ++p) {
                addEdge(y + tm * n, x + (tm + 1) * n, 1, d * (2 * p + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int tm = 0; tm < TIMES - 1; ++tm) {
            addEdge(i + tm * n, i + (tm + 1) * n, k, 0);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        augmentOne();
    }

    cout << totalCost << '\n';
    return 0;
}

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    static constexpr int MAXN = 14043;
    static constexpr int SOURCE = MAXN - 2;
    static constexpr int SINK = MAXN - 1;
    static constexpr long long INF = (long long)1e18;

    struct Edge {
        int to, cap, flow, cost;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int to, int cap, int flow, int cost) : to(to), cap(cap), flow(flow), cost(cost) {}
    };

    MinCostFlow() : total(0) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        adj[u].push_back((int)edges.size());
        edges.emplace_back(v, cap, 0, cost);
        adj[v].push_back((int)edges.size());
        edges.emplace_back(u, 0, 0, -cost);
    }

    void augment() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            dist[i] = INF;
            parent[i] = -1;
            parentEdge[i] = -1;
            inq[i] = 0;
        }
        dist[SOURCE] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(SOURCE);
        inq[SOURCE] = 1;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inq[v] = 0;
            for (int id : adj[v]) {
                if (edges[id].cap - edges[id].flow == 0) continue;
                int to = edges[id].to;
                int cost = edges[id].cost;
                if (dist[to] > dist[v] + cost) {
                    dist[to] = dist[v] + cost;
                    parent[to] = v;
                    parentEdge[to] = id;
                    if (!inq[to]) {
                        inq[to] = 1;
                        q.push(to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int cur = SINK;
        while (cur != SOURCE) {
            int id = parentEdge[cur];
            edges[id].flow++;
            edges[id ^ 1].flow--;
            cur = parent[cur];
        }
        total += dist[SINK];
    }

    long long cost() const { return total; }

private:
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<int> adj[MAXN];
    long long total;
    long long dist[MAXN];
    int parent[MAXN];
    int parentEdge[MAXN];
    int inq[MAXN];
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    MinCostFlow solver;

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        solver.addEdge(MinCostFlow::SOURCE, x, 1, 0);
    }

    const int TT = 101;

    for (int i = 0; i < TT; ++i) {
        solver.addEdge(i * n, MinCostFlow::SINK, k, i * c);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        --x; --y;

        for (int t = 0; t < TT - 1; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                solver.addEdge(x + t * n, y + t * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < TT - 1; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                solver.addEdge(y + t * n, x + t * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < TT - 1; ++j) {
            solver.addEdge(i + j * n, i + j * n + n, k, 0);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {

    }

    cout << solver.cost() << '\n';
